description: Configuration for cross-repository POM and test locations via GitHub API

targetRepo.name: OmegaAI-Mono
targetRepo.description: The repository containing the actual Playwright tests and POM files

cache.description: Local cache for filtered POM files and sync metadata

envVars.GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY: Your private key (PEM format, one line with \n)

github.description: Supports both GitHub App and Personal Access Token authentication

notes: 1. Run 'npm run sync-pom' or node github-sync-manager.mjs to sync from GitHub
2. System checks GitHub commit SHAs to detect changes (2 API calls)
3. Only downloads when files have changed on GitHub
4. Test files processed in memory and discarded
5. Only filtered POM files are cached locally (~3MB)
6. Runtime uses cached filtered POMs from .cache/filtered-pom/

legacy.description: Fallback to local filesystem if GitHub sync fails
